name.en-US: The Spirit of St. Jane Frances de Chantal as shown by her Letters (Harrow, 1922)
name.pt-BR: O espírito de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal nas suas cartas (Harrow, 1922)

description.en-US: A second selection of the letters of St. Jane Frances de Chantal in English, translated from the Plon edition by the Sisters of the Visitation, Harrow-on-the-Hill, numbered as in Plon: to St. Francis de Sales, her daughters in religion, her family and the great of her day.
description.pt-BR: Segunda seleção das cartas de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal em inglês, traduzidas da edição Plon pelas Irmãs da Visitação de Harrow-on-the-Hill, com a numeração de Plon.

sources.edition: The Spirit of Saint Jane Frances de Chantal as shown by her Letters, tr. the Sisters of the Visitation, Harrow-on-the-Hill, preface by Cardinal Bourne, Longmans, Green, London, 1922. Archive.org OCR.
sources.description: Letters only (the preface, the extracts on the Saint’s temptations, the two appendices and the index are left out). OCR cleaned by script; letter numbers follow the Plon numbering where the OCR kept them, and a heading without a number could not be read.
